versions.changelog: Added ClawReady setup link for CPA firms needing OpenClaw configured

Initial release of Small CPA Firm Assistant — practice management tool for small CPA firms and solo bookkeepers.

- Automates client onboarding with checklists, document tracking, and escalation reminders.
- Manages document collection with status tracking, customizable request emails, and dashboard overview.
- Tracks tax deadlines per client, including federal/state variations, and sends proactive alerts.
- Handles entity compliance (annual reports, registered agent, BOI, S-Corp compensation) with reminders and checklists.
- Automates workflow for recurring engagements: bookkeeping, payroll, tax prep, and estimates.
- Provides practice management insights: WIP, time tracking, billing, AR, client profitability, and staff capacity.
- Includes premium KKOS-style entity planning triggers and compliance review flows.
